video_title: It's time to go big or go home...or maybe a bit of both
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies Fanttik as the sponsor of SYD and MACKY's August 8, 2026 English-language YouTube video and quotes the disclosure that the video is sponsored by Fanttik, maker of the X10 Ace Mini and X10 Ace Tiny air compressors. SponsorRadar tracks 234 Fanttik sponsorships across 140 creators, including Brian Unboxed (~82K), Cruiseman's Garage (~107K), and SYD and MACKY (~131K), demonstrating active spend with small and mid-size creators. Fanttik sells tangible automotive/outdoor tools and physical consumer hardware. Fanttik's official Affiliate Program publishes publish@fanttik.com as the Affiliate Team contact and offers sample support, commissions, and ongoing creator promotions.
